accepted.title: Samungli Mound No. 2
accepted.summary: A low archaeological mound at Samungli preserves part of the Quetta valley’s settlement record. The federal inventory describes surviving pottery and a mound near the village, distinguishing it from the valley’s other numbered archaeological sites.
accepted.sourceAuthority: Department of Archaeology & Museums, Government of Pakistan
